name: board_frame
prompt: A square slot-machine board frame seen straight on, for a premium cartoon slot game set at a night-time gas station: a thick polished chrome bezel with rounded corners, a glowing hot-red neon tube running all the way round just inside the chrome, small chrome rivets, a little red-and-cream enamel nameplate cap centred on the top edge (no text) and a matching smaller one on the bottom edge. The whole inside of the frame is EMPTY and fully transparent (a big empty square window taking about 88% of the width and height). Polished high-end cartoon illustration, bold black ink outlines, cel shading, glossy highlights. Fully transparent background outside the frame. No text, no buildings, nothing else.
